text:
Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection list, to be performed on an 
 annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Kamal Issy, tested by eng. Mohamed Hussein Sherif, accepted by general 
 manager 
 eng. Mohamed Kamel Afify and 
 approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour Power Station 
 and MPIS coordinator .
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued and 
 the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipment 
 as safety helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
Isolate the heating steam and all 
 valves (delivery & suction)
Mechanical isolation
Open the drains
Tools 
and Equipment
Elect welding equipment
Oxy-acetylene welding equipment
Grinding Mach & Sand Blast
Power supply panel
Air power supply (compressor)
Scaffolding & Hoisting
Spanner & Wrenches
Work to be 
carried out
Isolate the steam valves
Isolate the fuel oil valves
Open the drain valves
Check tank body and foundation
Check tank level indicator
Check tank charging valves
Check tank body painting
Check tank oil sludge drain valves
Check tank suction valves
Check tank heating 
 steam
Test the all works
Restore all valves to the operation normal position
Clean the area after repairing
